about: The key and mode suggestion's golden list (v3.2 chunk 14): each case a quantized doodle, Jam's written key and Collection and a built-in instrument, with the seed, the kept candidates (concert pitch) and the answer recorded on 2026-11-03. Compared in Node (tests/unit/jam/key-suggestion/key-suggestion.spec.ts) and in Chrome (tests/e2e/workspace/key-suggestion-in-browser.spec.ts). Never re-recorded.
